job_description[2]: a. IS Practice: Evaluate deployment, develop security solutions/Design, test information security/Ensure compliance with security standards (of Vietnam and International)

job_description[17]: Key Accountabilities (2)
job_description[18]: 2. Information Security Red team:
job_description[19]: - Implement the strategy to ensure information security:
job_description[20]: + Participate in the implementation of the Information Security strategy by providing input data on attack trends, forms of exploitation and risks arising in each period.
job_description[21]: + Participate in the implementation of the annual information security implementation plan, meet the business and operational needs of the bank through the implementation of information security testing programs for the technology activities of the Business.
job_description[22]: + Develop penetration testing methods, information security scanning scripts and security checks according to international standards such as OSSTMM, Sans and OWASP.
job_description[23]: + Develop new techniques, exploit scripts and programs for automated penetration testing
job_description[24]: - Perform test attack activities:
job_description[25]: + Directly perform vulnerability detection review, vulnerability assessment, and conduct penetration/exploit testing periodically or at the request of the Block leader for all systems/applications; Penetration testing for system/application after live detection or whenever undergoing a major change. Testing methods must ensure practicality including both technical (technology) and non-technical (people, processes, physical assets). job_description[26]: + Perform regular vulnerability scans, information security checks to find vulnerabilities in the system and provide remedial / remedial solutions; supports maintaining compliance with world security standards such as PCI-DSS, ISO27001, SCP (swift).
job_description[27]: + Develop and manage vulnerability management program, threat intelligence database. Collect, track metrics, and analyze trends on cyber defenses, threats, detected attacks, vulnerabilities, and countermeasures/preventions.
job_description[28]: + Actively research / find new vulnerabilities, exploitation techniques and cyber threats; Identify trends in cybersecurity involving tactics, techniques, and processes, targeting for malware development and deployment.
job_description[29]: + Directly participate in the experimental plan of responding to an Information Security incident as an attack unit and in the case of an actual Information Security incident as the response team. Coordinate and provide expert cyber defense engineering skills to resolve cyber attack incidents

job_description[39]: + Change requirements on information security assurance solutions.

job_description[0]: Role overview
job_description[1]: You will be a core member of a forward-deployed engagement team that onboards enterprise customers (often highly regulated, high-maturity organizations such as banks) to an AI Data Analyst SaaS platform. Your primary responsibility is to design and implement robust data models and connections so the AI Data Analyst can reliably compute business metrics and answer analytical questions. This is a high-touch role combining deep technical data modeling and engineering with stakeholder management, requirements gathering, testing/validation, risk mitigation, and project delivery.

job_description[3]: • Customer liaison & discovery
job_description[4]: • Lead discovery sessions with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand source systems, data lineage, business definitions, and reporting needs.

job_description[6]: • Data modeling & metric engineering
job_description[7]: • Design logical and physical data models (facts, dimensions, hierarchies, slowly changing dimensions) that reflect customer business semantics and support the AI Data Analyst’s metric definitions.
job_description[8]: • Define canonical metric specifications (metric definition, calculation SQL/DSL, cohort logic, edge cases).
job_description[9]: • Platform integration
job_description[10]: • Implement data connections, ingestion pipelines, and schema mappings into the SaaS platform (or customer’s cloud data layer) ensuring freshness, reliability, and observability.
job_description[11]: • Configure dimensions, attributes, and metric metadata inside the platform so the AI models can consume and reason about the data.
job_description[12]: • Validation & QA
job_description[13]: • Develop and execute test plans to validate AI Data Analyst outputs against agreed-upon metric specs and ground-truth reports; quantify accuracy and identify root causes for discrepancies.
job_description[14]: • Create automated and manual validation suites (unit tests, reconciliation queries, data quality checks).
job_description[15]: Project & stakeholder management
job_description[16]: • Create project plans, manage timelines, set realistic expectations, and communicate status/risks to customers and internal stakeholders.
job_description[17]: • Facilitate sign-offs on metric definitions, data readiness, and production cutovers.
job_description[18]: • Risk, security & governance

job_description[20]: • Ensure implementations comply with customer security, data governance, and regulatory requirements.
job_description[21]: • Knowledge transfer & documentation
job_description[22]: • Produce clear runbooks, metric spec docs, and onboarding artifacts. Train customer users and internal support teams for ongoing operations.
job_description[23]: • Continuous improvement
job_description[24]: • Feed product/engineering with requirements and lessons learned to improve platform data modeling capabilities and onboarding playbooks.

job_description[0]: Job purpose
job_description[1]: Chịu trách nhiệm thiết kế và triển khai hệ thống kiểm soát chất lượng cho các sản phẩm AI từ PoC đến Production, đảm bảo sản phẩm đáp ứng các tiêu chí về hiệu năng, độ tin cậy, tính công bằng, khả năng giải thích và tuân thủ trước khi đưa vào vận hành thông qua:
job_description[2]: • Xây dựng khung kiểm thử với “cổng chất lượng” (quality gates) rõ ràng.
job_description[3]: • Thiết kế quy trình kiểm thử đánh giá độ chính xác, khả năng giải thích và tính công bằng của mô hình.
job_description[4]: • Phát hiện và ngăn ngừa rủi ro trước khi phát hành, tạm dừng roll-out và đề xuất biện pháp khắc phục.
job_description[5]: • Phối hợp cùng với AI Engineer, MLOps, PO AI để tích hợp các tiêu chuẩn QC xuyên suốt quá trình phát triển, huấn luyện và triển khai AI.
job_description[6]: Job Responsibilities
job_description[7]: 1. Xây dựng khung kiểm thử AI
job_description[8]: • Thiết kế và phát triển khung kiểm thử AI với quality gates cho từng giai đoạn PoC -> Staging -> Production.
job_description[9]: • Xác định chỉ số đánh giá phù hợp với sản phẩm AI: hiệu năng, độ tin cậy, tính công bằng, khả năng giải thích, mức độ phù hợp ngữ cảnh.
job_description[10]: • Xây dựng cơ chế kiểm thử theo hướng Data – Centric và mở rộng cho multi-agent.
job_description[11]: • Liên tục cải tiến khung QC dựa trên dữ liệu Production, phản hồi từ người dùng, DevOps, AI Engineer.
job_description[12]: 2. Triển khai & vận hành kiểm thử
job_description[13]: • Thiết lập và triển khai khung đánh giá rủi ro chất lượng AI: bias, drift, prompt failure, hiện tượng hallucination.
job_description[14]: • Xây kịch bản và tổ chức kịch bản kiểm thử AI:
job_description[15]: • Tự động: Kiểm thu hồi quy (regression), stress test đầu vào, kiểm thử chống phá (adversarial), kiểm thử thống kế (distributional tests).
job_description[16]: • Thủ công: Edge-case detection, kiểm thử trải nghiệm người dùng với đầu ra không cố định.
job_description[17]: • Tích hợp toàn bộ quy trình kiểm thử vào chuỗi CI/CD AI first: đảm bảo các bạn cập nhật mô hình đều được kiểm tra chất lượng trước khi triển khai thực tế.
job_description[18]: • Tham vấn và hỗ trợ AI Engineer, Data Team chuẩn hoá dữ liệu kiểm thử, lựa chọn ground truth theo từng use case và user segment.
job_description[19]: • Liên tục đánh giá hiệu quả Phương pháp, công cụ kiểm thử, nghiên cứu bổ sung giải pháp mới.
job_description[20]: 3. Đánh giá & ngăn ngừa rủi ro AI
job_description[21]: • Phân tích nguyên nhân lỗi: model bias, data drift, prompt failure.
job_description[22]: • Đề xuất và phối hợp triển khai các biện pháp remediation: huấn luyện lại mô hình, điều chỉnh prompt, tinh chỉnh tham số.
job_description[23]: • Thiết lập quy trình phê duyệt lại trước khi phát hành bản sửa.
job_description[24]: 4. Giám sát chất lượng Production
job_description[25]: • Thiết lập dashboard giám sát realtime toàn bộ hoạt động AI Production với các chỉ số cốt lõi: độ trễ phản hồi (latency), mức xử lý (throughput), tỷ lệ lỗi (error rate), sự bất thường đầu ra …
job_description[26]: • Chủ động đưa ra quyết định tạm dừng roll-out hoặc roll-back mô hình khi phát hiện các rủi ro vượt mức an toàn trong quality gate, kích hoạt các quy trình kiểm định lại đối với các model không đạt yêu cầu chất lượng, ảnh hưởng tới người dùng cuối.
job_description[27]: 5. Phát triển năng lực đội ngũ
job_description[28]: • Tổ chức workshop internal về phương pháp kiểm thử AI.
job_description[29]: • Soạn thảo tài liệu hướng dẫn, checklist kiểm thử cho từng loại agent.
job_description[30]: • Hướng dẫn Tester áp dụng khung kiểm thử AI đã chuẩn hoá, vận hành các công cụ kiểm thử.

job_description[1]: DAX tìm kiếm Senior Character / Style Guide Artist có kinh nghiệm xây dựng nhân vật và phát triển hệ thống hình ảnh theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế. Vai trò này giữ vai trò quan trọng trong việc định hình diện mạo nghệ thuật của nhân vật DAX, đảm bảo tính nhất quán khi ứng dụng cho merch, packaging, marketing và social media.
job_description[2]: Key Responsibilities/ Major Tasks/ Principal Accountability
job_description[3]: 1. Character Development
job_description[4]: • Phát triển nhân vật DAX với nhiều phiên bản chuyên sâu bao gồm biểu cảm, tư thế động, trang phục theo mùa hoặc chủ đề, phụ kiện và phiên bản nghệ thuật đặc biệt. Định hình và duy trì visual DNA của nhân vật, bảo đảm mọi hình ảnh thể hiện đúng tinh thần, tính cách và phong cách nhất quán trên mọi nền tảng.
job_description[5]: 2. Xây dựng và Quản lý Style Guide
job_description[6]: Thiết kế và duy trì Character Style Guide theo chuẩn studio quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống key visual, color system, logo/lockup, pattern và graphic elements, quy chuẩn áp dụng và hạn chế (do/don’t), hướng dẫn triển khai cho merch và packaging. Đảm bảo style guide mang tính hệ thống, dễ sử dụng, có khả năng mở rộng cho nhiều dòng sản phẩm tương lai.
job_description[7]: 3. Visual Asset Production
job_description[8]: • Thực hiện sản xuất visual cho các sản phẩm như apparel, lifestyle merch, sticker, tumbler, badge và bao bì.
job_description[9]: • Chuẩn hóa file theo tiêu chuẩn sản xuất thực tế, xử lý màu sắc, vector, bố cục và cấu trúc file để đảm bảo in ấn chính xác. Phối hợp với nhà máy và bộ phận kỹ thuật để kiểm soát chất lượng đầu ra.
job_description[10]: 4. Art Direction và Collaboration
job_description[11]: Đề xuất hướng nghệ thuật mới phù hợp thị trường Mỹ. Thực hiện moodboard, phác thảo, tinh chỉnh và hoàn thiện artwork theo quy trình sáng tạo chuyên nghiệp. Phối hợp chặt chẽ với team Marketing, Product và Creative. Có khả năng hướng dẫn, hỗ trợ hoặc mentoring cho artist cấp dưới (nếu có).
job_description[12]: 5. Research và Trend Sensitivity
job_description[13]: Nghiên cứu và cập nhật các xu hướng character design, pop culture và visual aesthetics tại thị trường Mỹ và quốc tế. Đánh giá và tối ưu hình ảnh phù hợp hành vi người dùng Gen Z và Gen Alpha. Đề xuất các ý tưởng nhân vật và concept mang tính viral hoặc có tiềm năng thương mại cao.

job_description[2]: POSITION OVERVIEW
job_description[3]: We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to lead quality assurance initiatives across our technology ecosystem. This role combines manual and automated testing approaches to ensure the reliability, functionality, and performance of our applications. As a Senior QA Engineer, you will establish testing standards, develop comprehensive test strategies, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software that enhances both customer experience and operational efficiency.
job_description[4]: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
job_description[5]: Design, develop, and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for web applications, mobile apps, APIs, and internal systems
job_description[6]: Lead the development and maintenance of automated test frameworks and scripts using industry-standard tools and best practices
job_description[7]: Perform thorough manual testing including functional, regression, usability, and exploratory testing across multiple platforms
job_description[8]: Design and execute performance, load, and stress tests to ensure application stability under various conditions
job_description[9]: Establish and maintain QA processes, methodologies, and quality metrics that align with agile development practices
job_description[10]: Conduct thorough analysis of defects, including root cause identification, and work closely with development teams on resolution
job_description[11]: Create and maintain test environments, test data, and documentation for all testing activities
job_description[12]: Lead test planning and estimation for new features and releases
job_description[13]: Mentor junior QA team members and promote quality-focused mindset across the organization
job_description[14]: Participate in code reviews from a quality assurance perspective
job_description[15]: Monitor and analyze application logs and metrics to identify potential issues before they impact users
job_description[16]: Stay current with emerging testing tools, technologies, and methodologies
job_description[17]: Work with product owners to ensure applications meet business requirements and user expectations
job_description[18]: Perform security testing and vulnerability assessments in coordination with the security team
job_description[19]: Ensure overall product quality by consolidating test results, quality metrics, and risk assessments into clear, actionable reports for stakeholders and leadership.

job_requirement[4]: Proficient in at least one programming/scripting language (Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.) for test automation
job_requirement[5]: Experience with API testing using tools like Postman, Rest Assured, or similar
job_requirement[6]: Knowledge of SQL and database testing

job_description[0]: Role summary
job_description[1]: The Enterprise Database Architect (Fintech) owns the design, modeling, optimization, and governance of Vietpay's core data systems. This role is hands-on and architecture-led. You will build and evolve relational, document, and graph data models, ensure high performance for transaction-heavy fintech workloads, and define standards that help engineering teams ship reliable microservices with clean data contracts. Strong experience in SQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, observability using Grafana, and working closely with middleware and engineering teams is required. Exposure to AI-enabled data workflows is a strong plus and you must be willing to learn new AI tools.
job_description[2]: Key responsibilities
job_description[3]: 1) Database architecture and data modeling
job_description[4]: • Own end-to-end data architecture for Vietpay's core platforms: acquiring, settlement, reconciliation, lending, risk, and reporting.
job_description[5]: • Design and document relational schemas, MongoDB document models, and Neo4j graph models aligned to business domains.
job_description[6]: • Define modeling standards, naming conventions, schema versioning, and change management practices.
job_description[7]: • Design data integrity patterns for fintech: ledgers, audit trails, idempotency keys, and reconciliation-friendly structures.
job_description[8]: • Partner with product and engineering to translate workflows into clean entities, relationships, and scalable storage patterns.
job_description[9]: 2) Performance, scalability, and optimization
job_description[10]: • Lead performance tuning across query design, indexes, partitioning, caching, and storage strategy.
job_description[11]: • Optimize for high-throughput workloads with strict correctness requirements: transaction posting, settlement, and reporting.
job_description[12]: • Define scaling approaches such as read replicas, sharding strategies, and workload separation where appropriate.
job_description[13]: • Review and improve slow queries and critical paths, establish performance baselines and regression checks.
job_description[14]: • Guide teams on efficient data access patterns and cost-aware design to reduce infrastructure spend.
job_description[15]: 3) Microservices and API-driven data systems
job_description[16]: • Architect database patterns that integrate cleanly with microservices and API layers (service-owned data where possible).
job_description[17]: • Define data consistency approaches (strong vs eventual), including event-driven propagation, outbox patterns, and retries.
job_description[18]: • Establish data contracts and integration guidelines with middleware teams to reduce coupling and failures.
job_description[19]: • Design strategies for deduplication, concurrency control, and safe retries across distributed services.
job_description[20]: • Support schema evolution across services without breaking production, including backward-compatible migrations.
job_description[21]: 4) Observability and operations (Grafana)
job_description[22]: • Establish database observability standards: metrics, alerts, SLOs, and dashboards.
job_description[23]: • Build and maintain Grafana dashboards for latency, throughput, errors, capacity, replication lag, and resource saturation.
job_description[24]: • Partner with DevOps/SRE on backups, restore testing, failover, and disaster recovery runbooks.
job_description[25]: • Support incident response and post-mortems, drive remediation to prevent repeat database-related issues.
job_description[26]: 5) Security, governance, and AI readiness
job_description[27]: • Implement security best practices: least privilege access, encryption, audit logging, and secure secrets handling.
job_description[28]: • Define governance for PII and sensitive financial data: retention, masking/tokenization, and access reviews.
job_description[29]: • Ensure architectures support compliance and auditability requirements for financial services.
job_description[30]: • Prepare data foundations for analytics and AI, structure datasets and metadata so teams can discover patterns and build models using modern AI tools.

job_description[1]: Vietpay is building an enterprise-grade acquiring and smart POS platform for nationwide deployment. We are hiring an Android Developer, Smart POS (Fintech) to develop and certify payment applications on Android-based POS devices, with deep hands-on expertise in EMV transactions, Level 2 and Level 3 certification, and secure transaction processing.
job_description[2]: This is a builder role that works close to hardware, cryptography, and scheme requirements. You will implement payment flows, integrate secure key management and HSM services, and lead certification execution with NAPAS and global schemes (Visa, Mastercard, JCB, UPI).
job_description[3]: Key responsibilities
job_description[4]: 1) Smart POS payment application development
job_description[5]: - Develop and maintain Android smart POS payment applications in Java, plus low-level modules in C and C++ where required.
job_description[6]: - Integrate with terminal peripherals and vendor SDKs: card reader interfaces, PIN entry, printer, camera or scanner, and connectivity stacks.
job_description[7]: - Implement end-to-end payment flows: purchase, reversal, refund, void, offline handling where applicable, and batch settlement.
job_description[8]: - Design robust error handling and recovery patterns that reduce transaction failures and support high merchant uptime.
job_description[9]: 2) EMV Level 2 and Level 3 certification leadership
job_description[10]: - Own day-to-day execution for Level 3 certification activities across NAPAS, Visa, Mastercard, JCB, and UPI, including test planning, evidence packs, and defect triage.
job_description[11]: - Support Level 2 certification readiness by aligning terminal behavior to kernel and scheme requirements, and coordinating with vendors and labs as needed.
job_description[12]: - Coordinate with acquirers, processors, device OEMs, and test laboratories to manage certification timelines, retest cycles, and final approvals.
job_description[13]: - Maintain certification documentation: test logs, traces, configuration baselines, version control tags, and release notes.
job_description[14]: 3) Security engineering, encryption, and HSM integration
job_description[15]: - Implement secure transaction processing, including EMV cryptographic requirements, secure PIN handling, and secure storage practices aligned to payment industry expectations.
job_description[16]: - Integrate with HSM and cloud HSM services for key generation, key injection workflows, key rotation, and secure distribution.
job_description[17]: - Build and maintain secure key lifecycle processes, including access control, audit logs, and operational runbooks for key management.
job_description[18]: - Partner with security and compliance stakeholders to ensure PCI-DSS and POI security practices are respected in design and implementation.
job_description[19]: 4) RTOS and embedded components (C/C++)
job_description[20]: - Develop and troubleshoot RTOS-based components or embedded modules used in payment stacks, device services, or performance-critical terminal functions.
job_description[21]: - Debug across application, middleware, and vendor layers, including device SDK behavior, drivers, and integration boundaries.

job_description[0]: Position Overview
job_description[1]: We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Security Administrator to join our technology team. This is a critical, hands-on role responsible for securing our entire digital footprint, from internal corporate systems to client-facing applications, including our proprietary solutions.
job_description[2]: The ideal candidate is a versatile, technology-agnostic problem solver. You must be able to analyze complex environments, design robust security solutions, and execute the necessary configurations. A key part of this role is the ability to propose the right solution for the business, whether it is a proprietary, commercial product (like Microsoft's) or an open-source alternative.
job_description[3]: You will be responsible for monitoring our security posture, responding to threats, and proactively hardening our systems. This position requires technical knowledge of both Microsoft environments and common open-source security platforms, along with a good understanding of application security. You will work hand-in-hand with our engineering team to integrate security into all aspects of our technology and will provide supervisory guidance on security-related tasks, reporting directly to the Head of Technology.
job_description[4]: Key Responsibilities
job_description[5]: 1. Analysis & Monitoring:
job_description[6]: • Proactively monitor and analyze security alerts from our security tools to detect, investigate, and respond to potential threats.
job_description[7]: • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and risk analyses across all corporate and client-front systems.
job_description[8]: • Analyze the security of our applications, identifying potential vulnerabilities in architecture and configuration, and working with engineering to prioritize remediation.
job_description[9]: 2. Solution Design & Proposal:
job_description[10]: • Evaluate the current security posture and propose practical, effective solutions and configuration changes to mitigate risks.
job_description[11]: • Evaluate and recommend new security technologies, comparing commercial and open-source solutions to determine the most effective and cost-efficient way to meet security objectives.
job_description[12]: • Design secure configurations for new and existing systems and applications.
job_description[13]: 3. Execution & Configuration:
job_description[14]: • Lead the hands-on configuration, implementation, and hardening of our Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Defender Suite, Intune).
job_description[15]: • Install, configure, and manage a diverse range of security tools, including selected open-source platforms (SIEMs, log management, vulnerability scanners...).
job_description[16]: • Execute remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities, including patch management and system reconfiguration.
job_description[17]: 4. Supervision & Collaboration:
job_description[18]: • Provide technical supervision and guidance to engineering and IT team members on the correct implementation of security controls and best practices.
job_description[19]: • Act as the primary technical point of contact for security incidents, coordinating the response between the technology team and management.
job_description[20]: • Work closely with the Head of Technology to develop, document, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures.
job_description[21]: • Liaise with the engineering team to ensure security is a core component of all new product development and system rollouts.

job_title: Full Stack Java Software Architect (Fintech, AWS, Microservices)
job_description[0]: Role summary
job_description[1]: Vietpay is hiring a high impact Full Stack Java Software Architect who can design and build enterprise grade middleware and microservices that connect multiple interfaces, including mobile apps, multiple web server systems, customer facing channels, and partner integrations. You will be hands on in Java development while also leading architecture decisions across APIs, data, messaging, cloud infrastructure, and reliability. Experience building or contributing to gamified platforms is a strong advantage, along with prior work in fintech, banking, or regulated financial services.
job_description[2]: Key responsibilities
job_description[3]: 1) Architecture and system design
job_description[4]: • Own service architecture and technical design for core platforms, including domain boundaries, service contracts, and integration patterns.
job_description[5]: • Design for resilience and scale: latency budgets, timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
job_description[6]: • Define API standards: versioning, error models, authentication patterns, and partner onboarding guidelines.
job_description[7]: • Create documentation that scales: architecture diagrams, decision logs, interface specs, and runbooks.
job_description[8]: 2) Java backend and middleware development
job_description[9]: • Build and maintain production services in Java using Spring Boot or equivalent frameworks.
job_description[10]: • Develop middleware orchestration services that connect internal systems and external partners.
job_description[11]: • Write clean, testable code with high engineering discipline: unit tests, integration tests, and code reviews.
job_description[12]: • Continuously improve performance and reliability through profiling, refactoring, and better data access patterns.
job_description[13]: 3) API and partner integrations
job_description[14]: • Deliver secure, stable APIs for customer and partner use cases, including webhooks and event driven flows where appropriate.
job_description[15]: • Integrate with banks, payment partners, and third party providers, ensuring auditability and operational supportability.
job_description[16]: • Implement robust monitoring for external dependencies and define clear operational playbooks for incidents.
job_description[17]: 4) Full stack delivery and cross team execution
job_description[18]: • Collaborate with mobile, web, product, QA, operations, and compliance teams to deliver end to end features.
job_description[19]: • Contribute to web application integration work when needed, ensuring frontend and backend alignment.
job_description[20]: • Translate requirements into technical plans, tickets, and release milestones, with clear trade offs and risk management.
job_description[21]: 5) Cloud, DevOps, and reliability (AWS)
job_description[22]: • Design and operate services on AWS with strong security and networking fundamentals.
job_description[23]: • Use containers and orchestration such as Docker and ECS or EKS, plus CI and CD pipelines for safe deployments.
job_description[24]: • Build production readiness into every release: logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerts, and on call handover.
job_description[25]: • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and post incident improvements.
job_description[26]: 6) Data and storage (SQL, Neo4j, MongoDB)
job_description[27]: • Own relational data design and query performance, including schema design, indexing, migrations, and reporting friendliness.
job_description[28]: • Work with or design solutions involving Neo4j for relationship graphs, and MongoDB for document workloads, as needed.
job_description[29]: • Ensure data integrity, access control, and audit trails appropriate for financial services systems.
job_description[30]: 7) Messaging and real time systems (optional plus)
job_description[31]: • Design and implement event driven flows for reliability and decoupling between services.
job_description[32]: • Experience with MQTT is a strong plus, especially for device and real time event streams.
job_description[33]: • Familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or SNS is helpful.
job_description[34]: 8) Gamification and engagement systems
job_description[35]: • Build or contribute to gamification features such as points, levels, badges, missions, streaks, and leaderboards.
job_description[36]: • Design gamification to be configurable, measurable, and safe, including fraud resistance and audit logging.
job_description[37]: • Partner with product and analytics to define engagement metrics and run controlled experiments.
job_description[38]: 9) Engineering leadership and standards
job_description[39]: • Mentor engineers, raise code quality, and influence best practices across teams.
job_description[40]: • Establish reusable service templates and libraries that speed up delivery while improving consistency.
job_description[41]: • Promote a professional international engineering culture: clarity, accountability, and calm execution under pressure.

job_description[4]: Primary Purpose:
job_description[5]: The Assistant Manager – IT supports the IT Leader in ensuring the stability, security, and efficiency of the organization’s technology infrastructure. This role oversees daily IT operations, drives project execution, manages vendors, and provides technical support to optimize system performance and user productivity. By ensuring effective IT governance and aligning technology initiatives with business objectives, the position contributes directly to operational excellence and organizational growth.
job_description[6]: Primary Duties & Responsibilities:
job_description[7]: Supporting the leader:
job_description[8]: Developing and implementing IT strategies, policies, and procedures. This includes contributing to budgeting, resource allocation, and vendor management.
job_description[9]: Overseeing Daily Operations:
job_description[10]: Monitoring and maintaining the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, hardware, and software. Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, ensuring system uptime and data security.
job_description[11]: User Support:
job_description[12]: Providing technical support to end-users, addressing hardware and software problems, and escalating complex issues to the appropriate personnel. This often involves training users on new technologies and software.
job_description[13]: Team Supervision:
job_description[14]: May supervise and mentor a team of IT technicians and support staff, providing guidance and training.
job_description[15]: Project Management:
job_description[16]: Assisting in the planning, execution, and completion of IT projects within budget and timeline constraints. This includes coordinating with vendors, stakeholders, and IT staff.
job_description[17]: Security Management:
job_description[18]: Implementing and maintaining security measures to protect sensitive data and systems. This includes managing access controls, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems. Staying up-to-date on security best practices and compliance regulations.
job_description[19]: Vendor Management:
job_description[20]: Liaising with IT vendors to negotiate contracts, manage service level agreements, and ensure the timely delivery of services.
job_description[21]: Documentation:
job_description[22]: Maintaining accurate and up-to-date documentation of IT systems, processes, and procedures.
job_description[23]: Staying Current:
job_description[24]: Keeping abreast of the latest technological advancements and industry best practices to ensure the organization's IT infrastructure remains modern and efficient. Ensuring that IT systems and practices comply with relevant regulations and policies.
job_description[25]: Budget Management:
job_description[26]: The process of creating, tracking, and adjusting a financial plan. It involves identifying income and expenses, setting financial goals, and making informed decisions about how to allocate resources. Effective budget management is crucial for individuals, families, and organizations to achieve their financial objectives and maintain financial stability.

job_description[15]: - Be in charge in expense management including working with all departments to optimize expense efficiency.
